about.title: Your electronics store, made simple
about.subtitle: VoltCart brings phones, laptops, audio, gaming and more to your door anywhere in Egypt, with honest prices and support you can actually reach.
about.story1: We started VoltCart because buying electronics should not feel like a gamble. Too often the price is unclear, the product is not what you expected, and nobody answers when something goes wrong.
about.story2: So we keep things simple: clear prices in Egyptian pounds, genuine products from brands you know, delivery to every governorate and payment only when your order arrives.

genuine.title: Genuine products
genuine.text: We list authentic items from trusted brands, with clear specifications.

prices.title: Clear prices
prices.text: The price you see is the price you pay. No hidden fees at checkout.

delivery.title: Delivery everywhere
delivery.text: We deliver to all 27 governorates and we call you to arrange the time.
